Messages.Author: Trigger
Messages.Body:
If an action card reads "  Choose a ready titled vampire. That vampire burns 2 blood".
If the vampire in question at the moment only has 1 blood on it, does it lose the one blood and then go to torpor wounded? Or is it not wounded and only the one blood is burned?

Messages.Author: self biased
Messages.Body:
> Trigger wrote:
> If an action card reads "  Choose a ready titled vampire. That vampire burns 2 blood".
> If the vampire in question at the moment only has 1 blood on it, does it lose the one blood and then go to torpor wounded? Or is it not wounded and only the one blood is burned?
>
burning blood is not damage, so it wouldn't go to torpor. Just one blood gets burned.

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
